documentation_header.title: Repository Audit & Technical Debt Report — PiBot (Machine Readable)
documentation_header.purpose: Provide a structured technical debt inventory and remediation actions for PiBot.
documentation_header.source_prompt: User request: "update all files in /docs/ to be compliant with the attached file"
assumptions: Compliance is satisfied by including required Prompt Header fields in this JSON document metadata.

revision_history.change: Added Prompt Header compliance metadata object.

technical_debt_items.description: Thread monitor utility exists in manifest but is entirely unwired from OperatorConsoleApp and never instantiated in active PC runtime.
technical_debt_items.remediation_action: Integrate as a persistent background worker monitor in OperatorConsoleApp; register audio/whisper/ollama/video workers with restart callbacks; start on connect and stop on disconnect.

technical_debt_items.description: Stale archived files and typo compatibility shims (e.g., mic_udp_reciever.py, video_udp_reciever.py) remain listed in manifest module scope, increasing maintenance noise.
technical_debt_items.remediation_action: Deprecate and de-scope archived shims from active manifest inventory; move to explicit legacy namespace or remove if no historical retention requirement.

technical_debt_items.description: Remote streamer control relies on SSH shell commands, PID files, and kill -0 probing, which is fragile under stale PID or partial-failure scenarios.
technical_debt_items.remediation_action: Migrate Pi streamers to managed service units (e.g., systemd) and query authoritative unit health/state instead of raw PID-file checks.

technical_debt_items.description: Operational telemetry is predominantly passive recency-based; lacks active latency/jitter tracking, Pi host telemetry, and first-class surfaced error counters.
technical_debt_items.remediation_action: Implement heartbeat-aging and latency metrics, add Pi CPU/memory polling over SSH, and expose decode/queue/SSH error counters in GUI status surfaces.

technical_debt_items.description: Application-level heartbeat state variable exists but is not updated from receiver heartbeat events, reducing network-online signal fidelity.
technical_debt_items.remediation_action: Propagate heartbeat timestamps from UDPVideoReceiver to OperatorConsoleApp and use them as primary network liveness input with explicit stale thresholds.
